cohort: 12,860 women in the Netherlands with one prior cesarean undergoing operative vaginal delivery or emergency repeat cesarean
finding: Attempted operative vaginal delivery was associated with an increased risk of neonatal birth trauma and postpartum hemorrhage, but a slightly lower risk of wet lung syndrome and neonatal convulsions compared to emergency repeat cesarean.
